tierReason: Photos add a table, signed Cloudinary uploads, synced writes and API endpoints; fits one cycle

decisions.decision: Tier Feature for #9, Sensitive Areas data, schema, api
decisions.why: New table, server-signed uploads holding a secret, and API endpoints with permission checks

decisions.decision: Involved people of a task are its creator plus its assignees
decisions.why: Same group as #8 and Decision 13; the user chose it at the mockup review

decisions.decision: Images use Cloudinary 'authenticated' delivery with signed URLs handed out only in the members-only photo list; links don't expire
decisions.why: Meets Decision 7 on the free plan; expiring token links need a paid Cloudinary plan

decisions.decision: Photos are resized to 1600 px on the longer side, JPEG, before upload
decisions.why: Keeps uploads small on mobile data while staying sharp enough for receipts

decisions.decision: The API answers 503 photos_unavailable when Cloudinary variables are missing, instead of failing at startup
decisions.why: Local dev and tests keep working before the user sets up Cloudinary

decisions.decision: Use Cloudinary's official Node SDK on the server and Expo's picker/manipulator modules on the phone
decisions.why: Prior art: official libraries avoid hand-written signature bugs; all Expo modules run in Expo Go
Migration order (lesson) and the task screen's section order depend on #8

decisions.decision: Stacked #9 on the #8 branch instead of waiting for #8 to merge
decisions.why: The user asked for both in one hands-off run; the photos migration then sorts after the comments migration and the task screen already has Bình luận. Merge #8 first.

decisions.decision: Photos UI departures: viewer token (black, scrim 0.55) added to tokens.ts, spinner instead of ring, viewer time uses the comment time format, caption sheet is a page-sheet modal
decisions.why: DESIGN.md has no black/scrim token; readability of white text; reuse of existing helpers and patterns

serviceActions: Create a Cloudinary account (free plan), then set CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME, CLOUDINARY_API_KEY and CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET in Render and in apps/api/.env

findings.text: projects/routes.ts:179 deleting a project cascades photo rows but doesn't destroy their Cloudinary images (orphans; spec R8 covers task delete only)
photos/routes.ts:209 vs :251 the 10-limit at sign is advisory; an image uploaded then refused at record (409) stays on Cloudinary
uploads.ts:75 vs :152 caption trimmed on upload but not on photoCaptionChange (server trims, likely harmless)
uploads.ts:115 every 5xx is retried while the comment at :122-123 mentions only 503
useTaskPhotos.ts:222-224 remove calls discardFailed before enqueueing the delete; a storage error loses the failed marker and the delete
Mobile: deleting a task doesn't remove its pending local photo files or queued uploads; a leftover upload would end as a failed item
Sensitive: projects/routes.ts:170-185 deleting a project cascades photo rows without destroying their Cloudinary images; non-expiring signed URLs keep working for former members (R5, R8, R10 intent)
Sensitive: /sign holds no place and isn't rate-limited; images uploaded but refused at record (limit, 404) or signed in bulk stay on Cloudinary; no format/size cap in the signature
Sensitive: /sign for an already-recorded id lets an involved person overwrite another person's image (Cloudinary overwrites by default)
Sensitive: task and photo DELETE await Cloudinary destroy (60s default timeout each) before answering 204
Re-review: routes.ts:273-277 any lockedTask error marked the upload orphaned (a DB error would destroy a good upload); fixed to 404 only
Re-review: a record refused with 403 (caller not involved) leaves the uploaded image on Cloudinary (storage leak only)
Re-review: the phone's 'already exists' upload check matches Cloudinary's message text; a wording change would make it a permanent refusal
Re-review: fire-and-forget destroys can be lost if the server exits right after answering; the image is then orphaned but unreachable by link
